title: All Souls' Eve
start: Speak to Death in the courtyard of the Harvest Hollow.

rewards.t: Furniture plans: Trick or Treat bowl (automatically unlocked)
rewards.l: Furniture plans: Trick or Treat bowl

rewards.t: Emotes from previous Halloween events (if not unlocked)
Bursting trick or treat bag (obtained during the quest), which contains:
rewards.l: Bursting trick or treat bag (All Souls' Eve)

steps.t: Talk to Death in Harvest Hollow. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'. › Accept]
Talk to Frank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to War. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Lady Grey on the stage to the southeast.
Go to the City of Um and search one of the pub tables around the stage in the city square to find Lady Grey's set list. You may have to search the same table multiple times.
Go back to Harvest Hollow and give Lady Grey her set list.
Talk to Frank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Famine. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Go to the Harvest Hollow bonfire to the southwest and use any five pieces of cooked food on the bonfire to burn it, which turns into ashes.
Talk to Famine. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Frank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Pestilence. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Go to the the Last Call pub in the City of Um and ring the bell at the southwest corner of the bar countertop to alert Bart.
Go back to Harvest Hollow and talk to Frank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Death. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Go to Death's office [Chat: 2 Continue 'All Souls' Eve'.] and talk to Death.

sub.t: Enter from Death's Hourglass in Draynor Village. [Chat: 2 Continue 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Enter from the Portal (War's Retreat) in War's Retreat. [Chat: 3 Continue 'All Souls' Eve'.]

steps.t: Interact with the Trick or Treat bowl in front of Death's desk.
Talk to Death.
Go back to Harvest Hollow and talk to Frank. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Talk to Death. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'All Souls' Eve'.]
Quest complete!
